subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Soap Opera's Eternal Engine
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Soap Opera's Eternal Engine usable.

hook.text: Guiding Light aired for 72 years—from radio in 1937 to television in 2009. It's the longest-running drama in history.

buildup.text: Soap operas air daily, five days a week. They produce more hours of content per year than any other TV format.

discovery.text: The secret is the cliffhanger. Every episode ends with an unresolved crisis that forces viewers to return tomorrow.

twist.text: Soaps were dismissed as lowbrow for decades. But serialized prestige dramas borrowed their storytelling techniques.

climax.text: Without soap operas, there would be no Breaking Bad or Game of Thrones. Serialized TV is a soap opera in a tuxedo.

punchline.text: Prestige TV owes everything to the shows critics mocked.

quiz.question: How long did Guiding Light air across radio and television?
